description: This file defines the AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageProvider class, which implements storage provider interface for state machines using Azure Append Blob Storage within an Orleans framework. It includes initialization, creation of storage instances, and lifecycle participation logic.

classes.name: AzureAppendBlobStateMachineStorageProvider
classes.description: Implements the storage provider for Azure Append Blob State Machine Storage using dependency injection and orchestrates lifecycle events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the storage provider by creating a client and initializing the blob container factory.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the storage for a specific grain context, configuring the Azure Append Blob client.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage provider to lifecycle events, specifically to initialize during the runtime initialization stage.
